I tried it, and the basics feel right. Putting the save box at the top above my list makes sense, saving with a button is fine, and yes — the title should be optional. Good so far.

Two things about the saving itself, though, since this is the part I care most about:

- When I saved `https://example.com` with the title "Example", it showed up fine — but when I leave the title blank, I'd really expect the app to go grab the actual name of the page for me, so I don't have to type it. Right now it just seems to show the web address as the name. Ideally when I paste a link, it fills in the real title (and ideally a short description and the little site icon) on its own, and then I can tweak it if I want.

- The other thing I mentioned before: if I try to save a link I've already saved, I don't want a second copy in my list. I'd expect it to recognize it and just take me to the one I already have so I can edit it.

Can we get those two working as part of this save flow? The rest of what you showed me is what I want.
